shellCommands.command: git status --short && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && cat package.json

node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(next|tsc)$'; grep -rn "no-store\|connection()" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/*fetch* 2>/dev/null | head -20

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "cache: 'no-store'" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn -B2 -A8 "cache: 'no-store'" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md 2>/dev/null | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json | head -20
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
